thread:
Ava (Marketing): Hey team — draft of the product launch post for Redwood Optimize is ready for review: https://docs.google.com/draft. Focus areas: headline, benchmark phrasing, legal, CTA -> webinar routing, and UTMs. Target publish Wed 10am PT. PTAL
Liam (Growth): Link opens. Quick note: headline feels generic. Can we be more specific about cost improvement? e.g., 'Reduce serving costs by 4x' — do we have the stat to back that?
Sam (PM): The 4x came from our internal 8k-token baseline run with batching + int8 quant on A100s vs baseline float. I'll paste the mini-table into the appendix.
Diego (Eng): I can confirm the numbers in release-2026/benchmarks.csv. Recommend phrasing 'up to 4x' and add a link to the full bench artifact rather than a hard claim.
Priya (Design): I can produce a hero image and two screenshots (dashboard + throughput graph). Need confirmation on hero size: 1200x600?
Maya (Legal): Skimmed draft. Please remove absolute/guarantee-type language (no 'guaranteed' or 'always'). Also we need source for the customer quote on latency — if it's from the beta, attach consent or anonymize.
Ava (Marketing): Good catch. I'll change headline to: 'Reduce serving cost by up to 4x with Redwood Optimize' and remove any 'guaranteed' phrasing. Will anonymize or attach consent for the quote.
Liam (Growth): For UTMs, propose: campaign=optimize_launch, source=blog, medium=organic. Webinar CTA should go to /webinar-register which posts to HubSpot form id=27. Example UTM: 
```
https://redwood.com/webinar-register?utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic
```
Sam (PM): Routing: ensure HubSpot form tags leads with "optimize_launch" and assign to SDR queue 'webinars'. @Carlos (Sales) can you confirm pickup?
Carlos (Sales): Confirm — leads with tag 'optimize_launch' will route to the 'webinars' queue. SLA: initial outreach within 24 hours. If high MQL score, escalate to AE.
Diego (Eng): Also added a short appendix section describing test configuration (model, seq len, batching, quant). Suggest the blog links to the public repo artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/optimize/bench-2026
Priya (Design): Uploaded hero_v2.png to the doc and attached the throughput graph (svg). Hero is 1200x630 — OK for social previews.
Maya (Legal): After the headline edit and anonymized quote, legal sign-off from me — approved.
Ava (Marketing): Updated the doc with new headline, appended the benchmark link, added UTM snippet, and replaced the quote with anonymized text. Scheduling for Wed 10am PT. Who will hit publish and queue social?
Liam (Growth): I can schedule the publish and handle social cadence. I'll publish the blog and trigger the HubSpot form mapping to ensure tags flow.
Sam (PM): Minor ask — add a one-line 'how we measured' callout under the benchmark graph so readers understand the context.
Diego (Eng): Done — added one-line callout in the doc.
Ava (Marketing): All thumbs? :thumbsup:
Liam (Growth): :thumbsup:
Carlos (Sales): :thumbsup: will monitor leads
Maya (Legal): :thumbsup: approved
Sam (PM): :thumbsup:
Priya (Design): :thumbsup:
Ava (Marketing): Thanks everyone — closing thread.
